references.text: Describes Israel's victory over King Og of Bashan, whom Moses and the Israelites defeated and took possession of his land.
Mentions that Moses had struck down Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Gives a detailed account of the victory over Og, king of Bashan, and describes him as the last of the Rephaim.
Notes that all of Bashan was called the land of the Rephaim.
Refers to what the Israelites did to Og, king of Bashan, as part of their conquests.
Lists Og, king of Bashan, as one of the kings the Israelites defeated, and describes him as one of the last Rephaim who ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
Describes how Israel took possession of Sihon's land, which was neighboring Og's kingdom.
Praises God for having struck down Og, king of Bashan, as a sign of His faithful love.
Mentions Og, king of Bashan, among the kings whom God defeated for Israel's sake.
Mentions the Rephaim in Ashteroth-Karnaim, linking to Og's capital and the people of the Rephaim.
